description: PS1 semi-transparent textures dumped from DuckStation (filenames tagged STP4 / STP8). Region-aware tri-state snap to exactly 0 / 143 / 255: flat semi-transparent surfaces keep DuckStation's semi value (143), while upscaled cutout edges are forced binary so they don't become blended halos on re-injection (DuckStation treats ANY alpha < 255 as 'blend this texel'). Preserves the existing alpha, no blur. Touches the alpha channel only — enable Edge dilation manually if you want RGB bled into the cut-outs to suppress halos. For non-STP (P4/P8) DuckStation textures use the binary cutout preset instead.
